posts.title: Welcome to My Blog
posts.excerpt: First blog post introducing this unique portfolio website.
posts.content:
Welcome to my blog! This is my first post on this custom OS-style website.

I built this interface to showcase projects and share thoughts in a unique way. The entire system is built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

Feel free to explore the different windows and try out the Alt+Tab functionality!

posts.title: Building a Window Manager in JavaScript
posts.excerpt: Technical deep-dive into creating a window management system with vanilla JS.
posts.content:
Creating a window manager from scratch is a fun challenge that teaches you a lot about DOM manipulation, event handling, and state management.

In this post, I'll share some key insights from building this system...

Key features include:
- Draggable windows
- Resize functionality
- Z-index management
- Keyboard shortcuts

posts.title: Design Philosophy
posts.excerpt: Why I chose a dark minimal OS aesthetic for my portfolio.
posts.content:
The design philosophy behind this site is rooted in minimalism and nostalgia.

I wanted to create something that feels familiar yet modern - combining the classic desktop metaphor with contemporary design trends like dark mode and monospace typography.

The neon blue accent color adds a cyberpunk touch while maintaining readability and professionalism.
